subject: Renewal: coordinating EU residency + staged APAC cutover and capacity upsell
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Emma Larsen <emma.larsen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal: coordinating EU residency + staged APAC cutover and capacity upsell

Hi Emma —

Hope you had a good week. We're preparing ClearWave's renewal and wanted to align on two items that came up during our internal review: data residency for EU-hosted patient datasets, and an APAC capacity add-on you mentioned in the last call.

Proposed, high-level:
- Renewal term: 12 months starting 2026-09-01, with the option to extend to 24 months at the same committed rate if you sign by 2026-09-15.
- EU data residency: keep primary storage in EU region (Frankfurt). We'll provide a Private control plane and customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest so EU data never leaves the EU storage tier.
- APAC: staged rollout — reserved APAC capacity (2x dedicated GPUs) for burst and low-latency inference, with cross-region failover enabled only for non-PHI inference traffic. Full APAC residency (persistent storage in APAC) would be an addendum.

Two asks from our side before we finalize SOW:
1) Confirmation that PHI must remain in EU-only storage for the life of the contract (we'll wire this into the SOW).
2) Agreement on an APAC cutover timeline: we suggest a deferred cutover (pilot traffic → 30-day validation → go-live) to limit risk.

I've looped Marissa to track renewal logistics; Vivek will chime in with the technical plan (cc'd on follow-up). If this matches your expectations we can send a draft addendum and network failover diagram next week.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: none in this message
From: Dr. Emma Larsen <emma.larsen@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 14:37:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal: coordinating EU residency + staged APAC cutover and capacity upsell

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirmed: PHI must remain in EU-persistent storage. We cannot have PHI at-rest outside EU for any environment (prod or warm-standby).
- APAC need: our APAC pilot team (Singapore) needs low-latency models for inference during business hours. We do not need full APAC residency day 1, but we will need the option to activate persistent APAC storage within the contract term if product adoption in APAC expands.
- Cross-region failover: acceptable for stateless inference only (responses and caches). Any email/text outputs that could contain de-identified patient metadata are ok to fail over to APAC temporarily, but anything that touches raw PHI must either stay in EU or be pseudonymized before routing.

Next steps on our side: procurement has asked for the SOW addendum + a diagram of the network failover and a brief note about how KMS integration will work. Can you provide those by next Tuesday (30 Jun)? Also send a pricing line for an APAC reserved burst capacity (monthly reserved + per-peak token billing).

--
Emma Larsen, PhD
Head of Data & AI, ClearWave Health
emma.larsen@clearwavehealth.com

Thanks,
Monica

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Renewal: coordinating EU residency + staged APAC cutover and capacity upsell

Monica / Marissa —

Attached: network-failover-diagram.png and a short technical note (excerpt below) for the SOW.

Technical summary (for SOW):
- EU residency: production volumes will be stored in EU S3-equivalent storage in the Frankfurt region. Customer-managed KMS (Bring Your Own Key) will be used; primary keys will be created and stored in the customer's EU KMS/HSM and only key-wrapping operations will be exposed to Redwood under strict access controls and audit logging.
- APAC staged setup: provision Dedicated APAC pool (initially 2x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved), routed behind a region-aware load balancer. APAC will serve inference for non-PHI or pseudonymized payloads.
- Failover behavior: prefix and KV caches are considered stateful and will remain EU-resident for PHI-sensitive models. Stateless in-memory caches for non-PHI can replicate to APAC to reduce cold-start latency. Failover triggers: region outage or latency SLO breach > 30s.
- Migration: enabling persistent APAC storage requires data migration with a controlled cutover window (minimum 3 business days) and a migration-runbook to avoid duplicate processing.

I'll hand off the full note for the SOW and the diagram to Monica to send to procurement. ETA: final draft files uploaded to Drive by EOD.

— Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Monica / Marissa —

Thanks for the drafts. Procurement has reviewed the SOW addendum and the network diagram. A couple of final asks before we route to legal:

1) Please add a short clause that the APAC reserved capacity will not be used to store or process PHI unless and until ClearWave signs the persistent APAC storage addendum.
2) We require a one-time migration credit if Redwood performs a data copy for persistent APAC enablement (we propose a 50% credit on the migration labor line if Redwood executes the copy).
3) Confirm DocuSign routing: sign order should be ClearWave (Emma) -> Redwood legal -> Redwood finance.

If you can incorporate these three bullets into the next SOW version we will aim to return a countersigned agreement by 2026-08-05. Thanks — we appreciate the flexibility on the pilot discount.

Best,
ClearWave Procurement Team
procurement@clearwavehealth.com
